punchline: Faraday sent Davy a finished volume of his own notes instead of a wish.
thirty_sec: In 1812 Michael Faraday heard Humphry Davy's last lectures, wrote his notes out in a quarto volume and sent them to Davy. Davy answered on 24 December 1812, and Faraday joined the Royal Institution in early March 1813.
question: In the field you want to master, what could you show the right person this week that you made yourself?
key_contrast: A bound volume of notes instead of a promise.
